title: CSM Technologies IPO Day 1: Issue opens today. Check GMP, key dates, review. Apply or not?
summary: CSM Technologies IPO is set from June 24-29, 2026, with an anchor investor raise of ₹20 crore. The price band is ₹107-113 per share, aimed at qualified institutional and retail investors.
